gambatte.note: The boot ROM follows the model (gb_bios.bin or gbc_bios.bin), not a region.

gb-cgb-flag.description: CGB flag at 0x143, bit 7 set means the cartridge runs in Game Boy Color mode.
gb-cgb-flag.note: The destination code at 0x14A is not read by gambatte. Its meaning is documentation, not code, so no region is decoded from it.
